significations.title: Self
significations.text: the querent: life, body, health, appearance, character

significations.title: Wealth
significations.text: money, possessions, earnings, gain and loss

significations.title: Siblings
significations.text: brothers and sisters, neighbours, short journeys, letters, news

significations.title: Home
significations.text: father, family, house and land, inheritance, endings, hidden things found

significations.title: Children
significations.text: pregnancy, pleasure, love affairs, gambling, gifts, messengers

significations.title: Illness
significations.text: sickness and its cure, work, servants and employees, small animals

significations.title: Partnership
significations.text: marriage, partners, contracts, lawsuits, open enemies, thieves

significations.title: Death
significations.text: death, fear, legacies, debts, other people's money

significations.title: Journeys
significations.text: long journeys, foreign lands, religion, learning, dreams and visions

significations.title: Honour
significations.text: career, reputation, rank, authority, employers, the mother

significations.title: Friends
significations.text: friends, hopes and wishes, patrons, benefactors

significations.title: Sorrow
significations.text: secret enemies, imprisonment, misfortune, self-undoing, large animals

houses.1: Restless and changeable; the querent's circumstances are in motion, health unsettled.
houses.2: Money comes and goes; nothing stays long in the purse.
houses.3: Much coming and going; news, letters and short trips, but little settled.
houses.4: Removal from the home or a change of residence; the matter will not hold.
houses.5: Pleasures are fleeting; a pregnancy or affair may not continue.
houses.6: Illness shifts and changes; servants or work are unsettled.
houses.7: A partner who drifts away; contracts and suits are unstable. Thieves get clear away.
houses.8: A change or passage; legacies and others' money slip through the hands.
houses.9: Excellent for journeys, especially by water; travel is indicated.
houses.10: Changes in career or position; honours do not last.
houses.11: Friends come and go; hopes change before they are met.
houses.12: Hidden troubles pass in time; confinement ends.

houses.1: The querent is swayed by those around them; outcome depends on other figures.
houses.2: Moderate gain, often through many small sources or through others.
houses.3: Many siblings, neighbours or messages; much talk and little substance.
houses.4: A crowded household or shared property; little change at home.
houses.5: Many children or many pleasures; a gathering or celebration.
houses.6: Illness is common and passes; work among many others.
houses.7: Many suitors or rivals; a partnership with the public. Thieves are many and hidden among others.
houses.8: Death of many or common danger; shared money and joint debts.
houses.9: Journeys in company; teaching or learning among a crowd.
houses.10: Public recognition or popular support; reputation rests on others' opinion.
houses.11: Many friends and acquaintances, but few true ones.
houses.12: Enemies hidden among the many; troubles shared with others.

houses.1: Peaceful and sound of mind; good health and a calm temperament.
houses.2: Steady, modest profit, especially through study, writing or trade.
houses.3: Good news, pleasant correspondence, and harmony with siblings and neighbours.
houses.4: A peaceful home; good for property and for matters ending quietly.
houses.5: Gentle pleasures; a healthy child, likely a daughter.
houses.6: Illness is mild and recovery sure; good for employees and work.
houses.7: A wise and peaceable partner; disputes settled by agreement.
houses.8: A peaceful passing; fair dealings in inheritance.
houses.9: Good for study, religion and wise counsel; journeys go well.
houses.10: Advancement through wisdom and good character, though slowly.
houses.11: Wise friends and modest hopes fulfilled.
houses.12: Secret enemies are weak; troubles are lightened by patience.

houses.1: The querent is drawn into a union or meeting; mixed in health and fortune.
houses.2: Money gained through partnership or by bringing things together.
houses.3: Meetings, messages and short journeys that join people together.
houses.4: Joint property or a shared home; lost things in the house are found.
houses.5: A union that brings pleasure or a child; good for conception.
houses.6: Illness lingers, especially from two causes combined; recovery is mixed.
houses.7: Very good for marriage and alliances; a lawsuit ends in agreement. Stolen goods are found.
houses.8: Inheritance shared with others; matters of death bound up with partnership.
houses.9: Journeys with a companion; meeting a teacher or guide.
houses.11: Friendships formed and hopes met through others' help.
houses.12: Hidden enemies combine against the querent; a confinement shared.

houses.1: A gentle, pleasant nature; good health and charm.
houses.2: Money for pleasures and adornments; modest, pleasant gain.
houses.3: Pleasant news and kindly neighbours; short, agreeable journeys.
houses.4: A pleasant, well-kept home; good for the household's women.
houses.5: Very good for love, pleasure and children, likely a daughter.
houses.6: Illness is not serious; pleasant work and willing helpers.
houses.7: Very good for love and marriage, though the partner may be fickle. Peace with enemies.
houses.8: A gentle passing; a small legacy, perhaps from a woman.
houses.9: Pleasant journeys; devotion and the arts favoured.
houses.10: Favour from patrons, especially women; honour through charm.
houses.11: Friendly company and hopes gently fulfilled.
houses.12: Troubles come through women or pleasures; enemies are soft.

houses.1: Weakness or loss of health; the querent is losing ground.
houses.2: Loss of money and goods; a poor time for investment.
houses.3: Loss of news or contact; trouble with siblings or neighbours.
houses.4: Loss of property or home; good only for the end of a matter.
houses.5: Good for love affairs, which consume the heart; bad for pregnancy.
houses.6: Recovery from illness, as the sickness passes away; servants may be lost.
houses.7: Good for love but poor for contracts; the case is lost. Stolen goods are not recovered.
houses.8: Loss through death or debt; legacies are spent or withheld.
houses.9: Journeys bring loss; faith or learning wavers.
houses.11: Friends lost or estranged; hopes fade.
houses.12: Good for the end of sorrow or release from prison; enemies lose their hold.

houses.1: Strength, vitality and long life; the querent prospers by their own power.
houses.2: Great gain and lasting wealth through one's own efforts.
houses.3: Good news and strong support from siblings and neighbours.
houses.4: A secure home and valuable property; a good inheritance.
houses.5: Success in pleasures and speculation; strong, healthy children.
houses.6: Swift recovery from illness; reliable work and helpers.
houses.7: Victory in lawsuits and contests; a strong, fortunate partner.
houses.8: A large legacy or gain through others' money; death is far off.
houses.9: Successful long journeys and spiritual progress.
houses.10: Great honour, advancement and lasting success.
houses.12: Victory over secret enemies; release from confinement.

houses.1: Good health and quick energy, but strength that is soon spent.
houses.2: Money comes quickly, but is quickly spent; help from others.
houses.3: Quick news and short journeys; help from neighbours.
houses.4: A move or change of home; property sold quickly.
houses.5: Quick pleasures; good for brief affairs, uncertain for pregnancy.
houses.6: Quick recovery from illness, though it may return.
houses.7: Success in a contest if it is decided quickly; a partner who helps but may not stay.
houses.8: Small, quick legacies; danger soon over.
houses.10: Advancement with others' help, but it may not last.
houses.11: Helpful friends; hopes fulfilled soon if at all.
houses.12: Escape from trouble; secret enemies are outrun.

houses.1: Bold and forceful, but rash; health is vigorous, with risk of accident.
houses.2: Money gained or lost through rash action; spend with care.
houses.3: Quarrels with siblings or neighbours; hasty news.
houses.4: Strife in the household; disputes over property.
houses.5: Passionate pleasures; good for love, risky for children; a son is likely.
houses.6: Fever or injury; quarrels at work.
houses.7: Good for love and for war; poor for peace or partnership. Open conflict.
houses.8: Danger of violent or sudden harm; disputes over legacies.
houses.9: Journeys that bring conflict; zeal in belief.
houses.10: Advancement through boldness and courage, especially in arms.
houses.11: Friends who are bold but unreliable; hopes pursued by force.
houses.12: Secret enemies are aggressive; trouble through haste.

houses.1: Traditionally a sign that the chart should not be judged: cast again later.
houses.2: Money lost through vice or passion.
houses.3: Quarrels and bad news; danger on short journeys.
houses.4: Strife at home; property damaged or lost.
houses.5: Passion and excess; good only for lust, bad for children.
houses.6: Fever, inflammation or injury; danger at work.
houses.7: Violent quarrels; a passionate but dangerous partner. Thieves are violent.
houses.8: Danger of violent death; disputes over money.
houses.11: False friends; hopes spoiled by passion.
houses.12: Dangerous secret enemies; imprisonment through violence.

houses.1: Good health and growth; the querent gains.
houses.2: Excellent for gain, profit and wealth.
houses.3: Gain through siblings, neighbours or news; profitable short journeys.
houses.4: Gain of property, land or inheritance.
houses.5: Gain through pleasures and speculation; a child is likely.
houses.6: Gain through work and employees; illness lingers, as the sickness gains ground.
houses.7: A profitable partnership; gain in lawsuits. Stolen goods are recovered.
houses.8: Gain through legacies and others' money.
houses.10: Advancement and gain in career and honour.
houses.12: Gain through hidden matters; but secret enemies also gain strength.

houses.1: Health, happiness and good spirits; a long life.
houses.2: Prosperity with contentment; money spent on joy.
houses.3: Good news, happy reunions with siblings and neighbours.
houses.4: A happy home; good for building or improving property.
houses.5: Great happiness in pleasures and children.
houses.6: Recovery from illness and contentment at work.
houses.7: A happy marriage or partnership; disputes end well.
houses.8: A peaceful death or gain through legacies.
houses.10: Honour and advancement with good reputation.
houses.12: Relief from sorrow; secret enemies are overcome.

houses.1: Restriction and delay; the querent feels bound, health is slow to mend.
houses.2: Money is tied up or saved; gain is delayed but losses are held.
houses.3: Delayed news; estrangement from siblings or neighbours.
houses.4: A secure but confining home; property is held fast.
houses.5: Restricted pleasures; delay or difficulty with children.
houses.6: Chronic or lingering illness; drudgery at work.
houses.7: A binding partnership, for better or worse; a long, slow suit. The thief is caught.
houses.8: Death delayed or legacies tied up.
houses.9: Journeys delayed or prevented; rigid belief.
houses.10: Position is secure but advancement is blocked.
houses.12: Imprisonment or confinement; secret enemies have the querent bound.

houses.1: Sorrow, low spirits and weak health.
houses.2: Loss of money, though good for saving and long-term investment.
houses.3: Sad news; trouble with siblings or neighbours.
houses.4: Good for land, building and foundations; the matter ends.
houses.5: Sorrow in pleasures; trouble with children or pregnancy.
houses.7: A sorrowful partnership; lawsuits go against the querent.
houses.8: Grief through death; a legacy brings sorrow.
houses.9: Unfortunate journeys; deep but sombre faith.
houses.10: Disgrace or a fall in position.
houses.12: Secret sorrow, imprisonment or chronic trouble.

houses.1: A good beginning; the querent's fortunes are rising.
houses.3: Good news; a new start with siblings or neighbours.
houses.4: A new home or a good start in property.
houses.5: A new love or the beginning of a pregnancy.
houses.6: Illness begins, or a new position at work; recovery comes.
houses.7: A new partnership or the beginning of a contest, favourably.
houses.8: A new beginning after loss; legacies come.
houses.9: The start of a journey or a new course of study.
houses.10: A new career or rise in position.
houses.11: New friends; hopes begin to be fulfilled.
houses.12: Hidden matters come to light; release begins.

houses.1: Traditionally a sign that the chart should not be judged: cast again later.
houses.2: Money goes out; loss in old matters.
houses.3: An end to correspondence or ties with siblings or neighbours.
houses.4: Leaving the home; the end of a matter.
houses.5: The end of a love affair or pleasure.
houses.6: The end of an illness, or of a position at work.
houses.7: The end of a partnership or lawsuit, often unfavourably.
houses.8: Death or a final settling of debts and legacies.
houses.9: Return from a journey; the end of a course of study.
houses.10: Loss of position; the end of a career.
houses.12: Good for release from prison or the end of sorrow.
